data.summary: Fixed the multi-instance sync defect. ThemeToggle now subscribes to THEME_CHANGE_EVENT and the window 'storage' event, and its matchMedia handler re-reads the stored theme and only applies 'system' when that is the stored value. Cycle-and-persist moved to a cycleStoredTheme helper in theme.js, with a new applyStoredSystemTheme helper, both unit-tested. Local variables in theme.js, ThemeToggle.jsx and theme.test.js use var; the redundant CSS rule is removed. I could not run the tests here.

changedFiles.purpose: Add cycleStoredTheme and applyStoredSystemTheme helpers; use var for locals
Sync instances via THEME_CHANGE_EVENT and storage event; defensive matchMedia handler; use helpers
Tests for new helpers; var for locals

testsAdded.description: cycleStoredTheme persists and applies next theme; applyStoredSystemTheme applies only for stored 'system' and never overrides explicit light/dark

appliedFeedback: Hint 1: ThemeToggle listens to THEME_CHANGE_EVENT (setTheme from event.detail, normalized) and window 'storage' (re-reads stored theme when key matches), both removed on cleanup.
Hint 2: matchMedia handleChange calls applyStoredSystemTheme which re-reads localStorage and applies only when stored value is 'system'.
Hint 3: Kept useEffect-based init (SSR-safe), no regression in behaviour.
Hint 4: Added cycleStoredTheme and applyStoredSystemTheme to theme.js with unit tests; existing tests untouched.
Hint 5: Switched function-local const to var in theme.js, ThemeToggle.jsx, theme.test.js; module-level constants and arrow-function/hook consts remain const.
Hint 6: Removed the redundant .dark .border-t.border-gray-100 rule (.dark .border-gray-100 remains).

selfVerification.notes: No command execution available; tests were not run locally. Logic is straightforward and tests use injected fakes.
